metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Node-only CLI in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js:1) with supporting modules in [output/ical.js](/workspace/output/ical.js:1), [output/parser.js](/workspace/output/parser.js:1), [output/rrule.js](/workspace/output/rrule.js:1), and [output/util.js](/workspace/output/util.js:1). The tool supports:

- `ical parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
- `ical expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO-8601> --to <ISO-8601> --output <out.json>`

It parses VCALENDAR/VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL/VFREEBUSY/VTIMEZONE/VAVAILABILITY/AVAILABLE/VALARM, decodes parameters including RFC 6868 caret escapes, emits the required JSON schema, validates iTIP `METHOD` rules, expands RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE/EXRULE, applies `RECURRENCE-ID` overrides including `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE`, and resolves zoned local times from in-file `VTIMEZONE` definitions.

Verified with direct runs against sample `.ics` files covering plain events, zoned recurring events, point overrides, floating-time recurrences, and `THISANDFUTURE` shifts. One intentional limitation remains: non-Gregorian `RSCALE` is parsed and surfaced, but expansion emits `rscale_unsupported` rather than attempting full RFC 7529 calendar-system math.
